correctness.rationale: The formal Frobenius lift f(x^(p^k))^(p^m) = f(x^(p^(k+1)))^(p^(m-1)) mod p^m follows from the binomial valuations including p=2. Iterating from A(x)^(p^(2a)) gives A(x^(p^a))^(p^a) mod p^(a+1), with division by A(x) legitimate in Z[[x]]. Isolating degree p^(a-1) modulo p^(a+2) yields a residual coefficient congruent to -p^(a+1), so exact sharpness. Independently read another public Git proof using telescoping ratios R_j=A(x^(p^j))^p/A(x^(p^(j+1))); it confirms the identical theorem, not its novelty.
